text:
maria-s: Quick check — we have a customer-facing demo next Monday and need a short training pass. Can we earmark ~8 A100s in us-west2 for a 3hr window (Mon 09:00-12:00 PDT)? Vendor told me some racks are on hold this week.
jonathan-k: Do we need dedicated reserved capacity or would a transient carve (best-effort preemptible) work for the demo? Preemptible could be cheaper but riskier.
maria-s: Need predictable run; can't risk mid-job evictions. Prefer short reserved carve if possible. Also need invoice/chargeback info so finance can tag it to the demo PO.
deepak: I can try a short-term reservation if quota allows. What's the charge code and who signs the temporary PO? Samira?
samira: Demo PO is DEMO-2026-03. Finance can approve a one-off charge for up to $8k. Procurement-bot, any fast path for a same-week carve?
procurement-bot: (automated) You can request a "capacity-hold" via vendor API with a 72h lead. For immediate needs, vendor-ops can open a short-term lease; requires approval flag = "expedite".
vendor-ops: We have a small block in us-west2 but it's currently untagged. If you submit the expedite flag + charge code we can mark 8 A100s as reserved for a 3h window. Note: if there's an earlier higher-priority commit we may preempt with 2h notice.
jonathan-k: Can you outline the exact API call? I can automate the request once I have the snippet.
vendor-ops: Sure, use this (example):
```
POST https://vendor.example.com/api/v1/reservations
{
  "region": "us-west2",
  "gpu_type": "A100",
  "count": 8,
  "start": "2026-03-23T16:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-23T19:00:00Z",
  "charge_code": "DEMO-2026-03",
  "meta": {"expedite": true, "owner": "maria-s"}
}
```
vendor-ops: Response will include reservation_id. Send that to finance to match invoice.
maria-s: Perfect — Jonathan, can you fire that off and cc procurement? I'll prep runbook.
jonathan-k: Will do in ~15m. Deepak, can you schedule the training job to tolerate a 2hr start jitter just in case? We can also shard across node groups.
deepak: I'll make the job idempotent and add checkpoints every 30m.
samira: Finance: please watch for invoice with reservation_id and route to DEMO-2026-03.
procurement-bot: (automated) Created procurement ticket #PR-9876 — vendor expedite approved pending reservation_id.
maria-s: Thanks all — tagging this thread for visibility. If vendor responds with a different window, we'll adjust start time and update the demo runbook. :thumbsup:
jonathan-k: Reservation request submitted, got reservation_id=rv_8A100_1755. Vendor confirmed via DM. I'll paste the confirmation here once they email.
vendor-ops: Confirmed on our side. We'll place the hold and send an official lease email.
maria-s: All set — closing the loop. If anything changes ping @maria-s directly.
